description: A rounded pouch has sloping upper sides beneath a broad arched metal frame. Two loop-shaped clasp knobs meet above the center, and an inset curved edge follows the purse opening.
A smooth S-shaped dollar mark has broad opposing curves and short horizontal ends. Small vertical strokes project above its upper end and below its lower end, aligned near the center.
A pig-shaped bank faces left with a square snout, pointed ear, two short feet, and a curled tail. A round coin with a vertical center mark enters the top of its curved back.
A rupee mark has two horizontal upper bars crossing a rounded bowl on the right. From the lower-left junction of the bowl, a long diagonal leg descends toward the lower right.
An open chest has a broad rectangular front with rounded lower corners and a small central latch. A domed mound rises behind its upper edge, surrounded by short radiating strokes.

A circular emblem contains interlocking angular blades arranged around a small central polygonal opening. The diagonal blade edges meet the outer rim, forming a continuous rotational pattern within the circle.
A tall P-shaped mark has a broad rounded upper bowl and two parallel vertical stems. A horizontal crossbar passes through both stems below the bowl and extends outward on each side.

Three narrow vertical ribbons stand side by side, each bending in an S-shaped wave. Their pointed ends extend slightly beyond the curved ribbon outlines, and the middle ribbon reaches lower than its neighbors.
Two open circular arcs form a broken ring crossed by a broad diagonal band rising to the right. The band has parallel edges, with its ends joining or approaching the circular outline.

A flat diamond-shaped top sits above a second offset angular layer, suggesting stacked slabs in perspective. Short vertical edges connect the corners to downward-pointing chevrons, with an open gap between the layers.
Three bent angular strokes interlock around a small open center. Their outer curves extend into two broad opposing arcs, producing a roughly circular swirling emblem with deliberate gaps.
A tall V-shaped mark has a broad outlined left arm that curves through a rounded bottom. Its right arm rises as a single straight diagonal stroke, giving the letter an asymmetric ribbon-like form.

Two separate shallow curved chevrons face away from each other. The upper stroke dips to a rounded central valley, while the lower rises to a matching rounded crest, with diagonal ends spreading outward.
